raw.description: Potential for reflected XSS due to direct insertion of user input into the DOM without sanitization.
raw.exploit: An attacker could craft a search term containing malicious JavaScript code that would be executed in the user's browser when the search results are displayed.

raw.description: Hardcoded database credentials in the source code.
raw.exploit: An attacker with access to the source code could use these credentials to connect to the database and potentially access or modify sensitive data.

raw.description: Potential CSRF vulnerability in the contact form submission due to lack of CSRF tokens.
raw.exploit: An attacker could trick a user into submitting the form on their behalf by embedding a form submission request in a malicious website.
